title: Westerbeke Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) gasoline generators for CNRSW Port Operations
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC SAN DIEGO.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR  SAN DIEGO
description_text: This is a COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION for commercial products prepared in accordance with FAR Part 12, using the Simplified Acquisition Procedures under FAR Subpart 12.2, as supplemented with the additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; a written solicitation will not be issued. PAPER COPIES OF THIS SOLICITATION WILL NOT BE AVAILABLE. This combined synopsis/solicitation SHALL be posted on SAM.gov. The Solicitation number N0024426Q0033 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for a Brand Name Only requirement for Westerbeke Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) gasoline generators for CNRSW Port Operations. In accordance with FAR 5.201(c)(3), the required Brand Name justification is attached. The NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center, San Diego, Regional Contracting Office requests responses from qualified sources capable of providing Westerbeke OEM Gasoline Generator 7.5 MCGB 058285.
